band of repeated elements along the upper edge
animal or creature shown in profile

justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, outline-driven relief in pale stone, with a row of repeated small motifs running along the upper edge, a prominent disc, a rectangular recessed field, and profile creature forms below — a loose structural echo. But A is a broken, horizontally-oriented fragment displayed against black with heavily abraded, ambiguous forms, while B is an upright monolith in situ whose crisply cut, clearly legible animals are stacked vertically, so the correspondence stays at the level of generic technique rather than a shared composition.
